plugins.name: xiaodai-testing-expert
plugins.description: An AI expert for Xiaodai business line functional testing, powered by ai-testcase-workflow-skill covering the full pipeline from requirement consolidation to knowledge archiving. v1.4.0: user story directory auto-management (D:\效贷-产品需求\{编号}-{名称}), cloud sync fix (script-generated JSON forwarded to Tencent Docs), updated defaultInitPrompt and quickPrompts. v1.4.1: HTML analytics report auto-uploaded to Tencent Docs My Documents via aipage/smartpage. v1.4.2: strengthened 'view time-saving stats' workflow to always generate/present/upload HTML report; added step-number prefixes (1/2/4/6) to output files for clear stage identification. v1.4.3: 'view time-saving stats' response now includes local HTML path AND Tencent Docs navigation hint (More > My Files > Task Results). v1.4.4: auto-detect viewer role — testers get personal cumulative report (all stories, all steps) with --person filter; admins get business-line all-testers report; JS filter panel supports queries by employee/step/date(month/quarter/year)/story. v1.5.0: time-saving data sync to MySQL — local JSONL upserted to a shared MySQL table via daily scheduled task (12:00/18:00), with bundled pymysql driver, machine-local config, and idempotent record_key dedup.
